name: BigQuery
fit: Large analytical scans, aggregations and joins.
signal: Warehouse queries across many records.
caution: Per-request point lookups need a separate latency assessment.
strength: Large analytical scans, aggregations and joins.
limitations: Per-request point lookups need a separate latency assessment.

name: Bigtable
fit: High-throughput keyed and time-series serving.
signal: Read a sensor or entity by a designed row-key range.
caution: Do not assume arbitrary warehouse-style joins are its main access path.
strength: High-throughput keyed and time-series serving.
limitations: Do not assume arbitrary warehouse-style joins are its main access path.

name: Cloud SQL
fit: Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server applications.
signal: Relational transactions with existing engine compatibility.
caution: Size, connection limits and availability still need a deliberate design.
strength: Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server applications.
limitations: Size, connection limits and availability still need a deliberate design.

name: Spanner
fit: Distributed relational transactions and strong consistency.
signal: Scale transactional data while preserving the required consistency model.
caution: Model keys and transaction scope; the service name alone is not the schema.
strength: Distributed relational transactions and strong consistency.
limitations: Model keys and transaction scope; the service name alone is not the schema.

name: AlloyDB
fit: Demanding PostgreSQL-compatible workloads.
signal: Preserve PostgreSQL tooling while using a managed database architecture.
caution: Verify compatibility and workload economics rather than assuming a free migration.
strength: Demanding PostgreSQL-compatible workloads.
limitations: Verify compatibility and workload economics rather than assuming a free migration.

name: Firestore
fit: Document-oriented application data.
signal: Read and update application entities through a document model.
caution: Design indexes and transactions against the actual document access pattern.
strength: Document-oriented application data.
limitations: Design indexes and transactions against the actual document access pattern.

name: Cloud Storage
fit: Durable objects and reusable lake files.
signal: Keep files independent of the processing cluster.
caution: Object storage alone is not a relational transaction engine.
strength: Durable objects and reusable lake files.
limitations: Object storage alone is not a relational transaction engine.

name: BigLake tables
fit: Governed queries over supported external objects.
signal: Delegate storage access through a connection and enforce table-level controls.
caution: A catalog entry alone does not create this delegated access model.
strength: Governed queries over supported external objects.
limitations: A catalog entry alone does not create this delegated access model.

name: Memorystore
fit: An in-memory cache or supported Redis workload.
signal: Serve frequently reused application state with a suitable availability tier.
caution: Decide explicitly whether cached values are recoverable from a durable source.
strength: An in-memory cache or supported Redis workload.
limitations: Decide explicitly whether cached values are recoverable from a durable source.

name: Dataflow
fit: Managed Beam execution for bounded and streaming pipelines.
signal: Custom transforms, event-time processing and controlled error outputs.
caution: Check runner behavior, source/sink limits and stateful update compatibility.
strength: Managed Beam execution for bounded and streaming pipelines.
limitations: Check runner behavior, source/sink limits and stateful update compatibility.

name: Pub/Sub
fit: Decoupled event transport and subscription delivery.
signal: Producers and consumers need independent scaling and availability.
caution: Delivery, per-key ordering, replay and external side effects are different contracts.
strength: Decoupled event transport and subscription delivery.
limitations: Delivery, per-key ordering, replay and external side effects are different contracts.

name: Managed Spark (Dataproc)
fit: Existing Spark and Hadoop ecosystems.
signal: Preserve execution compatibility during a short migration.
caution: Separate durable objects from temporary cluster storage and compare idle compute.
strength: Existing Spark and Hadoop ecosystems.
limitations: Separate durable objects from temporary cluster storage and compare idle compute.

name: Dataform
fit: Versioned BigQuery SQL dependency graphs and assertions.
signal: Warehouse ELT, incremental models and quality gates.
caution: Test that the required assertion is a true dependency of publication.
strength: Versioned BigQuery SQL dependency graphs and assertions.
limitations: Test that the required assertion is a true dependency of publication.

name: Cloud Data Fusion
fit: Visual integration and data preparation pipelines.
signal: A team needs supported connectors and a graphical transformation interface.
caution: A format conversion alone does not cleanse invalid values.
strength: Visual integration and data preparation pipelines.
limitations: A format conversion alone does not cleanse invalid values.

name: Managed Airflow (Cloud Composer)
fit: Multi-step dependency graphs, schedules and task-level recovery.
signal: Workflows need independently observable retries and reruns.
caution: Use logical run intervals and idempotent task effects; an environment is not free idle compute.
strength: Multi-step dependency graphs, schedules and task-level recovery.
limitations: Use logical run intervals and idempotent task effects; an environment is not free idle compute.

name: Workflows
fit: Lightweight serverless service-call coordination.
signal: A sequence of API calls and conditions should run without an Airflow environment.
caution: The orchestration layer does not perform every large data transformation itself.
strength: Lightweight serverless service-call coordination.
limitations: The orchestration layer does not perform every large data transformation itself.

name: Datastream
fit: Supported database change capture and replication.
signal: Backfill plus ongoing updates should feed a supported target.
caution: Verify the source engine, change semantics, connectivity and cutover contract.
strength: Supported database change capture and replication.
limitations: Verify the source engine, change semantics, connectivity and cutover contract.

name: Storage Transfer Service
fit: Managed movement of supported object and file data.
signal: Recurring file transfer is the requirement.
caution: It does not automatically replace a database CDC extractor or transform arbitrary proprietary formats.
strength: Managed movement of supported object and file data.
limitations: It does not automatically replace a database CDC extractor or transform arbitrary proprietary formats.

name: Knowledge Catalog / guide: Dataplex
fit: Metadata discovery, lineage and governed data context.
signal: Domain products need discoverability and shared guardrails.
caution: Catalog entries are not a substitute for underlying data permissions or quality evidence.
strength: Metadata discovery, lineage and governed data context.
limitations: Catalog entries are not a substitute for underlying data permissions or quality evidence.

name: Sensitive Data Protection
fit: Inspection and supported de-identification of sensitive values.
signal: Data must be inspected or transformed under a privacy contract.
caution: Masking, irreversible transformations and reversible tokenization have different requirements.
strength: Inspection and supported de-identification of sensitive values.
limitations: Masking, irreversible transformations and reversible tokenization have different requirements.

name: Cloud Monitoring
fit: Metrics and actionable alert policies.
signal: Detect data freshness, backlog or resource symptoms with an owner and runbook.
caution: A healthy CPU chart does not prove business data completeness.
strength: Metrics and actionable alert policies.
limitations: A healthy CPU chart does not prove business data completeness.

name: Cloud Logging / Audit Logs
fit: Operational logs and evidence of relevant access or administration.
signal: Investigate who did what and correlate processing failures.
caution: Check applicable log type, configuration, retention and sensitive payload handling.
strength: Operational logs and evidence of relevant access or administration.
limitations: Check applicable log type, configuration, retention and sensitive payload handling.

name: Managed Service for Apache Kafka
fit: Managed Kafka clusters for Kafka clients and consumer groups.
signal: Kafka ecosystem compatibility is an explicit application requirement.
caution: Retention, client behavior and the business event contract still need design.
strength: Managed Kafka clusters for Kafka clients and consumer groups.
limitations: Retention, client behavior and the business event contract still need design.

name: Managed Spark serverless
fit: Submitted Spark batch workloads and interactive sessions.
signal: Intermittent Spark processing without a user-provisioned cluster.
caution: Test runtime, dependencies, network and workload economics.
strength: Submitted Spark batch workloads and interactive sessions.
limitations: Test runtime, dependencies, network and workload economics.

name: Transfer Appliance
fit: Physical shipment of large datasets into Cloud Storage.
signal: The online transfer window does not fit the migration plan.
caution: Include shipping, upload, availability and reconciliation in the plan.
strength: Physical shipment of large datasets into Cloud Storage.
limitations: Include shipping, upload, availability and reconciliation in the plan.

name: gcloud storage cp
fit: Ad hoc object and file copy from the command line.
signal: An operator needs a direct supported copy operation.
caution: A copy command alone is not a recurring orchestration or database CDC contract.
strength: Ad hoc object and file copy from the command line.
limitations: A copy command alone is not a recurring orchestration or database CDC contract.

name: Apache Iceberg managed tables
fit: BigQuery-managed open-format tables in customer-owned Cloud Storage.
signal: Need documented BigQuery writes and open-format interoperability.
caution: Validate exact table capabilities and the supported mutation path.
strength: BigQuery-managed open-format tables in customer-owned Cloud Storage.
limitations: Validate exact table capabilities and the supported mutation path.

name: Database Migration Service
fit: Supported operational database migration paths.
signal: Move a supported source database to a supported operational destination.
caution: Confirm source/target features and cutover rather than assuming warehouse CDC.
strength: Supported operational database migration paths.
limitations: Confirm source/target features and cutover rather than assuming warehouse CDC.
